data.text:
apiVersion: elderlygate/designer/design/v2
kind: Block
metadata:
  id: CMP-KIOSK
  title: The kiosk
  tags:
    - edge
    - touched-by-a-person
spec:
  place:
    group: GRP-EDGE
    role: adapter
  state:
    status: decided
  code:
    service: locker.kiosk
    implements: kiosk/main.go
  source:
    where:
      - test/fixtures/design/README.md#the-edge
  description: |
    The only block a person touches. It knows a door number and a parcel
    barcode, and nothing else — no addresses, no names, no ledger.

    🟢 That narrowness is the point: the kiosk is the block most likely to
    be replaced, and the one with least to carry over when it is.
